in_sanskrit.name: Bhabesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of happiness
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhabesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘bhava’ meaning happiness and ‘ish’ meaning lord. Bhabesh is the name of a deity who is believed to bring happiness and joy to one's life.
